changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO user_module_access (user_id, module_key, allowed) SELECT u.id, 'platformAccess', TRUE FROM users u JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id WHERE r.name = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN' AND u.company_id IS NULL AND COALESCE(u.module_access_custom, FALSE) = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_module_access a WHERE a.user_id = u.id AND a.module_key = 'platformAccess' );
